steps.name: Mafioso F
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Mafioso G
steps.text: What's the matter with you? You telling me a little kid in the city with a bow and arrow is giving you trouble—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Mafioso G
steps.text: Gah! My knee!

steps.name: Mafioso G
steps.text: Run boys, run!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You can come out now, Measuring Cup. They're gone.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: N-No, I'm fine. Thanks...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Good. I'm the pack leader for now, so I can't let someone like you who can't fight go in front.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: But... there was no need to fight in the first place.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Those city wolves thought we'd be easy prey. All I did was draw my bow, but I hadn't even fired before they all came running over.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Drawing your bow on a bunch of gangsters who wouldn't think twice about killing you... Isn't that a bit reckless?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: When you run into danger, you bare your fangs. Isn't that the basics of self-defense? What do you think, Agnese?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Besides, they weren't strong. If we were in the wilds, I could have handled them on my own, easy.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *sigh* Though you're the one who provoked them, you did take care of it on your own, so I guess I can't complain. We should get back to town before we miss our truck.

spans.text: *sigh* Though you're the one who provoked them, you
take care of it on your own, so I guess I can't complain. We should get back to town before we miss our truck.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Back to town?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Well, yes. We've already paid for our tickets, and if we don't get back soon we won't be able to board—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Hey, that's our convoy! They're coming this way! Let's get on!

steps.name: Rapidly Approaching Voice
steps.text: Sorry guys, this town's famiglia are our clients too, so—

steps.name: Rapidly Fading Voice
steps.text: —We can't take you along this time.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: They left?!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: What do we do now, Lunacub?!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: ...I dunno.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: You're not supposed to admit that!

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Measuring Cup, you've been with us for a few years now, right? But you've never taken any days off.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I feel like if I did, I'd have to ask someone to take over my work while I'm away, and I'd really rather not trouble anyone like that.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: You and your coworkers already manage the cafeteria together. Don't you cover for them when they take time off?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Still, asking them to help me is a bit...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: (Shrugs) Whatever. So why now, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Th-This is totally different! This is an Emperor concert! I have all his albums! I've always wanted to go see him live!

spans.text: Th-This is totally different! This is an
concert! I have all his albums! I've always wanted to go see him live!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I've already run the numbers. If Rhodes Island maintains its current route, the concert in Nuova Volsinii will be closest!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Also, I promised everyone who's covering for me one of his vinyls...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: What? Aren't those expensive? And you promised one for everyone?

spans.text: What? Aren't those expensive? And you promised one for

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I mean, they're doing my work for me. I've gotta show them my sincerity somehow...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: You... It wouldn't kill you to loosen up now and then, would it?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Okay, so you've already handed off your work... Oh, right, you're not Siracusan, are you?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I'm not, but I did read five different Siracusan travel guides from cover to cover.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: It's a pretty chaotic place at the best of times. I'll go look for an operator familiar with the region. They can be your guide.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Oh, I wouldn't want to trouble anyone else. Why don't I just—

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Look, would you rather not trouble anyone, or would you rather get to see Emperor's concert?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I, well... Thanks for going to the trouble...

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Looks like the only person familiar with Siracusa who's onboard right now is Operator Lunacub. You two alright with that?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Oh, do you know each other already?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Is there anyone on the cafeteria management team who doesn't know her?

spans.text: Is there anyone on the cafeteria management team who

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: What about you, Lunacub?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I don't mind. I was getting bored waiting around Rhodes Island anyway.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: If you don't want her as your guide, you'll have to go to Siracusa by yourself. You think you can manage?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Honestly, if I hadn't been pressured into taking you as my guide back then, do you think I'd be sitting in that truck right now?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I don't remember pressuring you into anything.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I meant the lady from HR. She went out of her way to find you, so if I'd refused, wouldn't that be letting her down?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Does not agreeing with her count as letting her down?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Err, I didn't mean it that way...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *sigh* The travel guides never said what to do if I couldn't board a convoy...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: If you still want to go to Nuova Volsinii, we can follow their tracks.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: A convoy is different from a wolf pack. It has to stick to a road, and can't just go where it likes.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: There's nothing but sand next to the road though. Nothing to hunt either. Are you sure you want to walk?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: If the convoy always follows this route, we might be okay. Maybe we can hitchhike.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hitchhike? It will be a hike, yes, but what are you hitching yourself to?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: It means when we see a car, we can ask for a ride.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: How much longer are you going to take, Measuring Cup? I'm starving.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Real soon, I promise! Just a little longer!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) If I factor in everything, it'll take us ten days to reach Nuova Volsinii, so I should divide our rations into ten...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) Definitely need to hide what's left over, can't let her find them...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Are you done yet?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: It's done, it's done!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Here, our meal for today.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: We've still got lots of rations, so why are we eating so little today?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: All our plans assumed we'd be on a convoy right now, not whatever this is... It's about a ten-day walk, so this is all we can spare for today.
Lunacub eats her own portion in a couple of bites, then walks in front of Measuring Cup and tears open the bundles he had just painstakingly wrapped.
He tenses up, afraid that she will find the rations he so carefully hid away, but after some rummaging, she takes some leather, their Rhodes Island uniforms, and a frame.
When he sees her setting up a tent by the fire, he breathes a sigh of relief.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) Maybe I'm just a tad neurotic.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I'll help set up the tent too, Lunacub—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: My uniform?!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: And yours too?!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I told you before we left that these clothes are too thick for this season.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Now that our plans have changed, the stuff you brought is actually pretty useful. It'd be a shame not to make a tent out of such high-quality fabric.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: But now that our uniforms are ruined, I'll need to write a report to explain this to Logistics when we get back...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Sounds like a pain. They wouldn't tell me where the supply rooms are, but I managed to find one that even they'd forgotten about.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hey, are you going to help me with the tent or not?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: How are you feeling?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Great...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You don't look great. Why hide it?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: The sun is scorching. I feel like I'm about to dry out... But if we stop to set up camp, we'll fall behind schedule.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I was wondering what you were trying to do. Here.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Those things you call 'umbrellas' are pretty useful, so I made one from the tent frame and some fabric. Some parts were too complex though, so you can't fold it up without taking it apart.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Thanks—Hey, wait, this fabric... Is this my uniform?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Yes. You weren't using it, were you?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: True...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight... We still have eight days worth of rations—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Don't just stand there! A sandstorm's about to hit us! We need to move, quick!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: But the sky's still clear.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Don't you smell the sand in the air?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Watch out. The riverbed's flat, but there's a gloompincer nest down there. Stay close to me if you don't want to get pinched.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: How can you tell?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: The mud's a different color—Hey, watch out!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You mumble a lot, but your food is so good.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I usually don't like how gloompincer meat smells funny, so I only risked catching this one so I wouldn't have to sleep on an empty stomach.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Well, I do work in the cafeteria, you know.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) One, two, three, four, five, six... There's still some gloompincer from yesterday, too. Good, good...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Counting your rations again?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Lunacub?!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: No need to hide them. I figured out which layer you wrapped them in a long time ago.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Thanks for leaving them alone...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Why do you say 'thanks' all the time? You always say you don't want to trouble him or her or whomever, but... that word alone is troubling enough.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: So stop thanking me and tell me about this 'hitchhiking.' Where is this car that's waiting for us?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: It's not waiting for us, we just need to encounter one... *sigh* It's been five days and we haven't seen a single car pass by. Our luck's just horrible.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I saw some fresh tuskbeast dung, so there's probably a pack nearby. I can't tell if this is one I know, but where there's a pack, there's prey.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: We can follow the prey, wait until they head towards the closest city, then take a car from there back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: But... Nuova Volsinii...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You can't make it to the concert. But if you listen to me, you won't go hungry.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: ...But I still want to go!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Go and do what?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I took two whole months off to go to Nuova Volsinii! I can't just give up now!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Even if the concert is over, I still want to go! I want to go cry my heart out at the theater entrance! I want to buy the merchandise! I want to hear the last echoes of that once-in-a-lifetime experience!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hmph, I guess it's only at times like these that you actually speak up.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Am I being too stubborn about this? I've been wondering that for a while now.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Why? Isn't it normal want to do what you want?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Well... I think a lot of people can't do that.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Now that you say it, people in the city do seem like that.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Only ever worrying about what other people think, without even asking, until you're too afraid to do anything. Even though no one's stopping you.

spans.text: Only ever worrying about what other people think, without even asking, until you're too afraid to do
. Even though no one's stopping you.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Or insisting you want to do something that's too much for you, so you and everyone else are just fed up with it afterwards.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Is this some kind of 'cunning'? Something you do so you don't go hungry when you can't catch any prey?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *sobs*...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: What now?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) Your 'worrying about what others think' thing reminded me that I definitely need to get to Nuova Volsinii. I promised all my colleagues those vinyls...

spans.text: (Muttering) Your 'worrying about what others think' thing reminded me that I
need to get to Nuova Volsinii. I promised all my colleagues those vinyls...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: *sigh* I don't get you at all.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: That's fair, I don't really get me either...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Lunacub, your rations.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Lunacub?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Huh? Oh.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: You seem rather absent-minded. What's wrong?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I can smell the tuskbeast pack.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Tuskbeast pack... Oh right, I remember hearing that you lived with a pack of beasts before you came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: It must have been interesting going from that to the landship, and seeing all those unfamiliar things.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Eh, there were a lot of things I hadn't seen before, some good to eat, some fun to play with, but I don't like seeing a ceiling when I wake up.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: If Agnese hadn't asked me to wait there, I might just leave. Dunno when, though.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Agnese... Where is that friend of yours, anyway?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: That... It's annoying to explain. Agnese is right here, next to me.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: ...Huh?

Measuring Cup fears that he has somehow offended her and hastily tries to explain himself, but Lunacub does not react at all. She is staring with rapt attention at thin air. It is difficult to tell if she is looking at something near or far away.
As the bonfire crackles in the silence, Measuring Cup suddenly hears the howling of the tuskbeast pack, far in the distance.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Lunacub, are you... thinking of returning to the pack?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Huh? What did you say? I was listening to Agnese just now.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: ...Never mind.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: The tent's all set up. You can turn in early if you want to sleep.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: That pack of tuskbeasts is calling out again, but Lunacub wouldn't really go rejoin her old pack, right?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *sigh* She's taught me so much these past few days. Guess I still can't get the upper hand...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *siiiiigh* Why am I even thinking about this stuff...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Steady breathing)

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Yawn) What was that? Lunacub? Is something going on?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Lunacub? Lunacub!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Nobody's here?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Sh-She said... that where there are tuskbeasts, there's prey, so I just have to wait here...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Who cares what she told me? I need to check on the rations.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: They're all gone?!
A trail of footprints leaves the west side of camp, a perfect fit for Lunacub's shoes.
In desperation, Measuring Cup grabs the cooking pot by the fire. Then, fearing it won't be enough, also snatches a large fork before hurriedly following the footprints.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *pant* *pant* *pant* ...Lunacub! Lunacub, where are—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: If you're going to run off without a word, you could have at least left me some rations.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You idiot, how am I supposed to lure sandbeasts without bait? We won't always stumble over easy prey like those gloompincers.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: You didn't have to abandon me either—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Stupid!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I'm not just hunting for myself, I'm hunting for the both of us—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Do you want to die?!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: What's happening?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: It's fine if you want to help, just stop asking questions and come over here!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: A tuskbeast pack? I thought you guys were friends?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I don't know every pack in the Siracusan wilds. They couldn't catch any sandbeasts on their own, so now they're here to snatch someone else's prey. Hmph.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Well... Can you talk things out?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: What's there to talk about? There's only one sandbeast. Either we eat, or they eat. Do you want to go hungry?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I... I was just wondering if we could come to a peaceful resolution.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You'll starve to death if you keep thinking like that!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I thought you left that blind consideration behind when you talked about the concert. If we don't eat that sandbeast, we both starve. And if we starve, then you're missing the concert!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Can you walk? They'll close in on us soon. If you're gonna run, you'd better run soon!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Deep breath) I-I-I'm not going to run!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Good. You don't need to go anywhere, just stand here. When I yell 'hit it,' then hit that pot as hard as you can!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Hit... the pot?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: I'm the pack leader, so listen to me! You need to scare them! Scare them bad! If the pack wins, we lose! There's no 'peaceful resolution' here! If you don't fight for what's yours, nobody is going to just give it to you!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Will you do it or not?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: ...Alright!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Okay…

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hit it!
The sound of thick metal clashing against metal resounds through the woods, distracting the tuskbeasts who have never heard such a sound before and stopping them in their tracks.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Got you now!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hit it again!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Again! Harder!
After three rings of the pot, three tuskbeasts fall to the ground, pierced by arrows.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: The next time I say 'hit it', I need you to hit that pot as hard as you can and for as many times as your arms can handle! The harder and faster, the better!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: HIT IT!
The tuskbeast pack is pushed back by a barrage of chaos. The raucous din of clanging metal overlays the volleys of arrows being fired wildly, all while their fellows drop to the ground one by one.
In the end, the matriarch of the pack cries out twice, and they quickly retreat into the forest.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: They're gone. We should get this sandbeast back to our camp as soon as we can.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I've got a question, and maybe this is insensitive, but those tuskbeasts you killed, couldn't we also...?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Heh, so you've finally stopped mincing words like a city person. I don't know how useful that is in the city but here in the wild, it's best to just get to the point.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: But forget about those tuskbeasts. I'd rather not start a feud with them if we don't need to.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You were a big help just now, but you were still pretty wimpy. I'd say the only—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Yeowch! That's hot!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: (Chewing) The only thing I can't complain about is your cooking.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Muttering) And after I played such a big part...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: What did you say?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I said I played a big part earlier!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Hmph. I guess so, otherwise all you'd be getting are the claws.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: And how's that fair? Even if I didn't go and help, I'd still be the one cooking it for you!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Well, who asked you to starve me every day?! Even if we're in a rush, a handful of rations is way too little!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: The only reason we even have a handful of rations left is because of my planning!

spans.text: a handful of rations left is because of my planning!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: So you've finally learned to speak your mind?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Huh? I... I guess I have.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Good! I'm not a mind reader. I'll only know what you're thinking if you tell me.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: If you keep hiding things away instead, I'm going to forget all the good things you've done.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Then I'd like you to be honest with me. How much do you think I've helped out during our trip?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Um...
Lunacub does not answer, using a small knife to carve up a sandbeast haunch instead. The meat sizzles atop the grill for a while before a piece is given to Measuring Cup.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: What should we do once we finish eating? Do we need to move camp so that pack won't come back for us?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Wow, you only just learned to speak up and you've already learned to cover your tracks too? Very good.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Never mind what I learned, I actually feel like I'm... happier?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Happy? That's good too, right? If your stomach's full then it's normal to be happy. Maybe you'll be qualified to be part of my pack when we reach Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: 'Reach Nuova Volsinii'?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: *sobs*...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Now what?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: The concert... My concert...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Slow down! If you keep going this fast, you'll get tired before noon—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Look, Lunacub! Isn't that a car stopped by the side of the road?

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Hey, you two! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around my car like that—

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Gah—

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: ...Isn't this the driver that took your 'payment' but still left us by the roadside? Is this that 'hitchhiking' thing you were talking about?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Shrugs) I suppose so.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Mister Driver, we're not going to ask for our money back. We'll be satisfied if you just take us to Nuova Volsinii, okay?

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: I'd love to, but this lousy car of mine's broken down, and I can't repair it alone.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You're not alone. There are three of us.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: If you still can't, then give those pieces of paper back to Measuring Cup. We can walk.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Pieces of paper?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: She means the fare we paid.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: ...Sure, why not? If you two can help me fix my car, I'll grit my teeth and take you to Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Well, it should be fixed now.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Ah, no, no can do, my car here's got some quirks, see. You need to wait a while after opening up the hood, or it won't start up—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Sounds like it's working alright to me.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Oh, er, yeah. Looks like that went away all of a sudden.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: We'd best get moving then. An hour saved is an hour saved! And the concert's tonight!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Hold on, isn't Nuova Volsinii supposed to be that way?

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: It's a shortcut. Aren't you in a hurry? I'm taking us the fastest way I know.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Measuring Cup, what's that sound?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: A communicator. Maybe there's someone nearby who's using one too, and their signal is interfering with this one.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: That's right! I'll speed up a bit, and we'll be there before you know it!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: No. This isn't the way to Nuova Volsinii. Stop.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: We're almost there! You don't know what you're talking about, girl! Buddy, can't you keep that kid under control?

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Buddy?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: You're right. With the weather being this hot, we should get under some shade.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Ah, thanks. This umbrella of yours is real unique. Is it... made out of clothes?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Yeah, that girl over there made it. I've learned a lot of things from her. She even wants to be my pack leader, and honestly, I've been seriously considering the offer.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: I... I see.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Any particular piece of the sandbeast you want?

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: Nah, I'm good, I'm not really hungry—Hey, why're you covering my eyes?! The hell do you think you're pressing—

steps.name: Mafioso A's Voice
steps.text: You got guts, Sante. Decided not to answer your comms?

steps.name: Mafioso B's Voice
steps.text: We ain't waiting no more. Whatever, we're nearly there. We'll help you fix your ride when we get there.

steps.name: Mafioso B's Voice
steps.text: When the car's fixed, you bring us to where you fobbed off those two stronzi who made a ruckus in the city. They can't have gotten far.

steps.name: Mafioso B's Voice
steps.text: Once we let off some steam with a few jabs of the knife, whatever they got on them is yours. We'll bump you joining the famiglia up the schedule, and soon you'll have your own driver you can boss around...

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Still thinking of a 'peaceful resolution'?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: (Shrugs) Let's give him one last chance, just in case he's stuck in a sticky situation.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Mister Sante, give us back our fare and get out of the car.

steps.name: Driver
steps.text: (Clenching teeth) As if! Wait until the boys get here—

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Sorry, but if you win, we lose. No peaceful resolution this time either.

Measuring Cup kicks the driver—dazed from a cooking pot to the head—out of the car and straps himself into the driver's seat. The car burns a semicircle into the road and disappears in a cloud of dust.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: See? It's like I said. In the wilds, if you don't fight for what's yours, nobody is just going to give it to you.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: So do you want to join my pack? I'm serious.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I'll think about it. But for now...

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii, here I come!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Em! Pe! Ror! Em! Pe! Ror! Em! Pe! Ror!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: I love you, Lunacub! We actually made it on time! You've been my lucky star this entire trip!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Ah... Right.

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: You came all this way... just to see that guy?

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Which guy? Who are you talking about?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Who else? The one on stage.

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: That's right! Have you never heard of Emperor? I've been a fan ever since I was in school! I even have all his vinyls! He—You know what, I'll tell you all about him after the concert!

steps.name: Measuring Cup
steps.text: Em! Pe! Ror! Em! Pe! Ror! Em! Pe! Ror!

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Agnese, did Measuring Cup nearly get himself killed just to see this guy shouting on stage?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Couldn't you just have called him over before we left? Wouldn't Measuring Cup have been satisfied with him shouting at him then?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: ...You'll consider your goal achieved once I can understand why he did what he did?

steps.name: Lunacub
steps.text: Alright... Well, I don't get it at all yet. It's too noisy.
Emperor raps along to the rhythm on the stage, his fanatical fans shouting, shrieking, and swaying below.

Lunacub looks at Agnese in confusion as she stands by her side, then back to Agnese's kin upon the stage. She pushes her way through the crowd with a bewildered expression, and makes her way out of the theater.
